items.title: 17.12 RLC series circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.12, Example 17.7 and an extra resonance example of ours (PDF 102-104).

blocks.text: Ek RLC series circuit lein jis ka AC source ki frequency badli ja sakti hai (Fig. 17.11(a)). Is ka impedance diagram Fig. 17.11(b) mein hai, jahan inductive reactance X_L = ωL aur capacitive reactance X_C = 1/ωC ek doosre ki ulti simt mein hain (ek upar, ek neeche).
RLC series circuit ki impedance:

blocks.alt: (a) AC source ke saath series mein R, L aur C, current I. Saath teen chhote graph: R ke liye Vo aur Io aik saath; L ke liye Vo chauthai chakkar aage; C ke liye Vo chauthai chakkar peeche. Ghoomta phasor daira XL ko +90 darje aur XC ko -90 darje par, 180 darje ke farq se dikhata. (b) Impedance tikon ABC: AB par R, BC par XL - XC, AC par Z, zawiya theta.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.11 (a), (b): (a) RLC series circuit aur us ka phasor diagram; (b) RLC series circuit ka impedance vector diagram (kitab ki Figure 17.11 (a), (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: X_L aur X_C ek doosre ki ulti simt mein hain (ek +90°, doosri −90°), is liye un ka farq X_L − X_C hi R ke saath milta hai: Z = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²). X_L bari ho to circuit RL jaisa, X_C bari ho to RC jaisa.
Zyada frequency par X_L = ωL, X_C = 1/ωC se bohat bari hoti hai; inductance ghalib (dominant) hoti hai aur circuit RL series circuit jaisa bartao karta hai.
Kam frequency par X_C = 1/ωC, X_L = ωL se bohat bari hoti hai; capacitance ghalib hoti hai aur circuit RC series circuit jaisa bartao karta hai (Fig. 17.11(b)).

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Kitab ceiling fan ki wiring ki tasveer dikhati hai (live wire, switch, running winding, capacitor ke saath starting winding, rotor) aur poochti hai: ceiling fan mein kaunsa AC circuit istemal hota hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: ceiling fan mein kaunsa AC circuit hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Capacitor-start (split-phase) motor circuit. Starting winding ke saath series mein capacitor laga hai, is liye us ka current running winding ke current se phase mein aage khisak jata hai. Do windings ke alag phase wale currents mil kar ghoomta (rotating) magnetic field banate hain jo rotor ko ghumata hai.

blocks.text: In dono ke darmiyan ek frequency ωᵣ aati hai jis par X_L = X_C. Is halat mein RLC series circuit sirf resistor (R) wale circuit jaisa ban jata hai (Fig. 17.11(c)).
Is halat ko resonance kehte hain. Resonance par X_L aur X_C barabar aur ulti simt mein hain, is liye ek doosre ko khatam (cancel) kar deti hain. Resonance frequency fᵣ is shart se milti hai:

blocks.alt: (c) Aik ufqi teer R: XL = XC par sirf resistance bachti hai. (d) Current I aur frequency f: resonance frequency fr par tez chotti, chotti par dashed lakeer, mehwar se chotti tak dohra teer aur dono taraf ufqi teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.11 (c), (d): (c) XL = XC par RLC series circuit sirf resistance ki tarah; (d) XL = XC par resonance (kitab ki Figure 17.11 (c), (d) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: RLC series circuit ki khaas baatein
Series RLC circuit aisa circuit hai jise alag alag frequencies par khaas bartao ke liye banaya ja sakta hai; is liye electronics mein bohat kaam aata hai.
1. Impedance aur resonance: resonance par impedance sab se kam (Z = R) hoti hai, aur resonant frequency:
2. Current: resonance par impedance sab se kam hai, is liye current sab se zyada hota hai (Fig. 17.11(d)).
3. Phase angle: resonance par phase angle zero hai: voltage aur current in phase hain aur power factor 1 hai.

4. Damping: resistor current ke jhoolne (oscillations) ko damp karta hai (dheema kar ke khatam karta hai). Zyada resistance = zyada damping, oscillations jaldi khatam. Gari ke spring par pahiye ki harkat RLC series circuit jaisi hai: shock absorber harkat ko damp karta aur energy kharch karta hai (resistance ki tarah), aur mass aur spring resonant frequency tay karte hain (Fig. 17.11(e), kitab mein tasveer).

5. Tuning aur filtering: RLC series circuits, khaas kar resonance par, radio receivers aur communication devices mein tuning (station pakarne) ke liye istemal hote hain. Yeh band-pass filter ban kar ek khaas frequency range ke signals guzarne dete hain aur baqi ko kamzor (attenuate) kar dete hain.

6. Voltage amplification: resonance par inductor aur capacitor par voltage lagaye gaye voltage se kahin zyada ho sakta hai, kyunke un ke darmiyan current ghoomta rehta hai. Ise voltage amplification kehte hain.
7. Power ka kharch: RLC series circuit mein power:

Ise true power (asal power) kehte hain. Sab se zyada power θ = 0 par kharch hoti hai, jo sirf resistor mein mumkin hai. Apparent power (zahiri power) sirf VI hoti hai (unit volt-ampere); power factor cos θ = true power / apparent power.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke apparent power 'VI cos θ ke barabar' hai. Sahi: apparent power VI (volt-ampere) hai; VI cos θ to true power hai (Eq. 17.27).

blocks.title: Example 17.7
blocks.problem: LCR series circuit mein inductor par 20 V, capacitor par 11 V aur resistor par 12 V hain. Kul voltage aur current ka phase difference, aur AC source ka Vᵣₘₛ nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: V_L = 20 V, V_C = 11 V, V_R = 12 V
θ = tan⁻¹(0.75) ≈ 36.8° (voltage current se aage, kyunke V_L > V_C)

blocks.title: Izafi misal (kitab mein nahi)
blocks.problem: L = 10 mH aur C = 1.0 μF wale series circuit ki resonant frequency nikalein.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: X_L = X_C par resonance: fᵣ = 1/(2π√LC); Z = R, current sab se zyada, power factor 1.
True power = VI cos θ; apparent power = VI.
